subject: Conditional Random Forest 'Errors' and 'OOB ROC' requests generate the following Error "operator not defined for this S4 class"

messages.author: 163f205fed4b4eb5
messages.subject: Conditional Random Forest 'Errors' and 'OOB ROC' requests generate the following Error "operator not defined for this S4 class"
parts:
I initially ran into problems with my setup which were solved by the update suggested in the 'Rattle 3.0.4 for Mac OS/X available - resolves all currently known issues' thread, until now.

My setup
Rattle 3.0.4 r192

R version 3.1.0
OSX 10.9.3

The Problem
After running a conditional random forest the following errors are generated when the 'Errors' and 'OOB ROC' buttons are pressed. From the console:

Error in crs$rf$votes : $ operator not defined for this S4 class

Error in crs$rf$err.rate : $ operator not defined for this S4 class

N.B. - I am new to these statistical techniques and Rattle so would not be surprised if the problem lay with the IBK.
